oe_wp35_bri_grant_letters_patent = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_open = { WHO = scope:oe_wp35_bri_patent_holder }
			province = {
				NOT = { is_in_list = oe_wp35_bri_patent_provinces }
			}
		}
		province = { add_to_list = oe_wp35_bri_patent_provinces }
		save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_patent_location
		scope:oe_wp35_bri_patent_claimant = {
			add_casus_belli = {
				target = scope:oe_wp35_bri_patent_location.owner
				type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent
				province = scope:oe_wp35_bri_patent_location.province
				years = -1
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_core_of = scope:recipient }
		remove_core = scope:recipient
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = scope:actor } }
		add_core = scope:actor
	}
	change_location_owner = scope:actor
}

oe_wp35_bri_add_cooldown = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes }
		add_cooldown = {
			type = $TYPE$
			years = $BRITAIN_YEARS$
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_cooldown = {
			type = $TYPE$
			years = $COMPANY_YEARS$
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_add_ai_reject_cooldown = {

				type = $TYPE$
				years = 5
			}

		else = {
			add_cooldown = {

			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {

		random_country = {
			limit = { oe_wp35_bri_oe_wp35_is_british_india = yes }
			save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_company_scope
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = oe_wp35_bri_company
			value = scope:oe_wp35_bri_company_scope
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_company }
		remove_variable = oe_wp35_bri_company
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:oe_wp35_bri_britain ?= { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing_unlocked }
		}
		set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing
	}

	set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_crown_locations value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_company_locations value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_contested_locations value = 0 }
	var:oe_wp35_bri_britain ?= { save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_britain_scope }
	sub_continent:south_asia = {
		every_location_in_sub_continent = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { oe_wp35_bri_held_by_british_india = yes }
				situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_company_locations add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:oe_wp35_bri_britain_scope
					oe_wp35_bri_held_by_side = { SIDE = scope:oe_wp35_bri_britain_scope }
				}
				situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_crown_locations add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_wp35_bri_contested_locations add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	set_variable = {
		name = oe_wp35_bri_total
		value = {
			value = var:oe_wp35_bri_crown_locations
			add = var:oe_wp35_bri_company_locations
			add = var:oe_wp35_bri_contested_locations
			min = 1
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = oe_wp35_bri_crown_share
		value = {
			value = var:oe_wp35_bri_crown_locations
			multiply = 100
			divide = var:oe_wp35_bri_total
			round = yes
			divide = 100
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = oe_wp35_bri_company_share
		value = {
			value = var:oe_wp35_bri_company_locations
			multiply = 100
			divide = var:oe_wp35_bri_total
			round = yes
			divide = 100
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = oe_wp35_bri_contested_share
		value = {
			value = 1
			subtract = var:oe_wp35_bri_crown_share
			subtract = var:oe_wp35_bri_company_share
			min = 0
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_ai_try_madras = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_local_variable = oe_wp35_bri_ai_bought }
			oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
			has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_madras_unlocked
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_madras_granted }
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_grant_of_madras }
			gold >= {
				value = oe_wp35_bri_madras_price_value
				add = oe_wp35_bri_ai_reserve_value
			}
		}
		sub_continent:south_asia = {
			ordered_location_in_sub_continent = {
				limit = {
					oe_wp35_bri_madras_candidate = yes
					owner ?= { is_ai = yes }
				}
				order_by = population
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = target
				owner = { save_scope_as = recipient }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:recipient
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_grant_of_madras|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_ai_pay_seller = yes
			scope:target = { oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes }
			set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_madras_granted
			add_truce_with = {
				target = scope:recipient
				years = 5
				mutual = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_ai_try_factory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_local_variable = oe_wp35_bri_ai_bought }
			oe_wp35_bri_unlocked = { FLAG = oe_wp35_bri_company_unlocked }
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_factory_grant }
			gold >= {
				value = oe_wp35_bri_buyer_income_value
				multiply = 0.5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes }
			save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_side
		}
		else = {
			overlord = { save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_side }
		}
		sub_continent:south_asia = {
			ordered_location_in_sub_continent = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					is_coastal = yes
					owner ?= {
						oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = yes
						is_ai = yes
					}
					controller ?= owner
				}
				order_by = {
					value = oe_wp35_bri_location_factor_value
					if = {
						limit = { oe_wp35_bri_presidency_location = yes }
						add = 4
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_neighbor_location = { oe_wp35_bri_held_by_side = { SIDE = scope:oe_wp35_bri_side } }
						}
						add = 20
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:oe_wp35_bri_side = { oe_wp35_bri_ai_live_take_west_indian_coast = yes }
							OR = {
								area = area:saurashtra_area
								area = area:konkan_area
								area = area:malabar_area
							}
						}
						add = 10
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:oe_wp35_bri_side = { oe_wp35_bri_ai_live_conquer_bengal = yes }
							region = region:bengal_region
						}
						add = 10
					}
				}
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = target
				owner = { save_scope_as = recipient }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:recipient
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_factory_grant|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_ai_pay_seller = yes
			scope:target = { oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes }
			oe_wp35_bri_add_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_factory_grant BRITAIN_YEARS = 1 COMPANY_YEARS = 2 }
			add_truce_with = {
				target = scope:recipient
				years = 5
				mutual = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

					}
					oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes
				}
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_add_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_landholding_rights BRITAIN_YEARS = 4 COMPANY_YEARS = 6 }
			add_truce_with = {
				target = scope:recipient
				years = 5
				mutual = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_ai_try_subsidiary = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_local_variable = oe_wp35_bri_ai_bought }
			oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
			has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing_unlocked
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance }
			gold >= {
				value = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_price_value
				add = oe_wp35_bri_ai_reserve_value
			}
		}
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = yes
				is_subject = no
				is_ai = yes
				num_locations < scope:actor.num_locations
				num_locations <= 60
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						is_subject_of = scope:actor
						is_at_war_with = prev
					}
				}
			}
			order_by = {
				value = num_locations
				if = {
					limit = { oe_wp35_bri_historical_subsidiary = yes }
					add = 100
				}
			}
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_ai_pay_seller = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				make_subject_of = {
					target = scope:actor
					type = subject_type:vassal
				}
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_add_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance BRITAIN_YEARS = 5 COMPANY_YEARS = 5 }
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_ai_fortify = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_wp35_bri_participant = yes
			is_during_bankruptcy = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_ai_fort_cooldown }
			gold >= {
				value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax
				multiply = 0.5
			}
			sub_continent:south_asia = {
				any_location_in_sub_continent = { oe_wp35_bri_ai_fort_site = yes }
			}
		}
		sub_continent:south_asia = {
			ordered_location_in_sub_continent = {
				limit = { oe_wp35_bri_ai_fort_site = yes }
				order_by = {
					value = population
					if = {
						limit = { is_coastal = yes }
						multiply = 2
					}
				}
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				oe_wp35_bri_ai_build_best_fort = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_ai_build_best_fort = {
	if = {
		limit = { can_build_building = building_type:fortress }
		construct_building = {
			building_type = building_type:fortress
			owner = root
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { can_build_building = building_type:star_fort }
		construct_building = {
			building_type = building_type:star_fort
			owner = root
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { can_build_building = building_type:bastion }
		construct_building = {
			building_type = building_type:bastion
			owner = root
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { can_build_building = building_type:castle }
		construct_building = {
			building_type = building_type:castle
			owner = root
		}
	}
	else = {
		construct_building = {
			building_type = building_type:stockade
			owner = root
		}
	}
	root = {
		set_variable = {
			name = oe_wp35_bri_ai_fort_cooldown
			days = 1095
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_name_east_india_company = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_subject = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_is_east_india_company }
			}
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = trade_company
				capital ?= { sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia }
			}
		}
		random_subject = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = trade_company
				capital ?= { sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia }
			}
			set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_is_east_india_company
			change_country_name = oe_wp35_bri_east_india_company_name
			change_country_adjective = oe_wp35_bri_east_india_company_name_ADJ
		}
	}
}
